speaker: Leonard
text: Cheese fries? Really? You love them? No reason. Just glad to hear you're comfortable saying you love something.

speaker: Penny
text: Yes, I love chili cheese fries. Yeah, why?

speaker: Penny
text: You really want to get into this right now?

speaker: Leonard
text: Get into what? Why wouldn't you love the chili cheese fries? They've been in your life a long time. They make you happy. They deserve to know.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, look, you just caught me by surprise last night. I didn't know what to say.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, well, now you've had some time to think about it. So what do you want to say? How can you not be sure?

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, this isn't the place to have this conversation.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, the place to have the conversation was in bed after I said I love you and you said thank you, good night.

speaker: Penny
text: Don't push it, Leonard. You are. You don't get to decide when I'm ready to say I love you.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, the premature I love you. I guess premature, does that count?
